segments.sn14.18:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dhātusova, bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.18:1.9: Atītampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu … pe … anāgatampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandissanti samessanti … pe ….
segments.sn14.18:2.1: “Etarahipi kho, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.18:2.3: ahirikā ahirikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti;
segments.sn14.18:3.7: paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti … pe … paṭhamavāro viya vitthāretabbo.(2)
segments.sn14.18:4.1: “Dhātusova, bhikkhave … pe … assaddhā assaddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti;
segments.sn14.18:4.5: saddhā saddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti; bahussutā bahussutehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti … pe ….(3)
segments.sn14.18:5.1: “Dhātusova, bhikkhave … pe … assaddhā assaddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti;
segments.sn14.18:5.6: āraddhavīriyā āraddhavīriyehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti; paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti … pe ….(4)
segments.sn14.18:6.1: “Dhātusova, bhikkhave … pe … assaddhā assaddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti;
segments.sn14.18:6.6: upaṭṭhitassatino upaṭṭhitassatīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti; paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti … pe ….
